policy: TruthBounty V2 accounting is token-denominated: no canonical contract holds, forwards, or accounts for native currency. Every native-value surface must be either an explicit rejection or a documented exception, and forced native balance (SELFDESTRUCT) must never create a claimable, reserved, reward, stake, bond, or treasury balance.

nativeValueSurfaces.rationale: Canonical rejection surface: receive() reverts with UnexpectedNativeValue for every transfer and both execute() overloads reject an attached msg.value, so execution can never be funded with native currency. Proposal operations must carry a zero native value (NativeValueProposalNotAllowed), enforced at proposal creation and again at execution, which keeps forced balance held on the governor or the timelock outside every governance path.

Interface documentation surface only: execute(uint256) stays declared payable so the ABI, selector, and integrator call sites are unchanged, while the implementation always reverts on a non-zero msg.value. The NatSpec states the native-value policy explicitly.

Deployment surface rejection: upgradeAndCall keeps the payable signature inherited from ProxyAdmin but rejects any attached native value, because a transparent proxy has no path that releases native currency and forwarded value would be permanently stranded in the proxy.

Test-only fixture that accepts and forwards native value to probe reentrancy handling. It is never deployed by a deployment script and is referenced only from test files, so it carries no protocol accounting meaning.

Adversarial test-only fixture that forces native value onto an address through a same-transaction SELFDESTRUCT, which is how the 'forced balance is inert' property is exercised. Not deployed and not referenced by production code.

Known exception, out of the canonical V2 surface: legacy standalone sample (payable constructor, withdraw() pays address(this).balance) that is not deployed by any V2 deployment script, is not a governed module, and holds no V2 accounting. Native value is therefore excluded from the V2 policy; the file is intentionally untouched to keep this change inside the governance and upgrade surface.
